_readme: Values here override anything the pipeline fetches. Edit weekly for vendor-gated metrics using free charts (checkonchain.com, lookintobitcoin.com, bitbo.io) or your Glassnode/CryptoQuant key. Delete a key to let the pipeline own it. '_src' keys are ignored by the dashboard — they are your provenance notes.

tier1._src_exchange_reserves: Glassnode via media, Mar 2026 (7-yr low). Update weekly.
tier1._src_bp: Estimate — replace from checkonchain balanced price chart.

tier2._note_etf_cum: Pipeline now computes etf_cum_usd from Farside's full daily table. Add an 'etf_cum_usd' key here only if you want to pin it manually.
tier2._src_rr25: Deribit 25d risk reversal — manual from Laevitas/The Block if not fetched.
tier2._src_urpd: $86.9K cluster per The Block cost-basis reporting, May 2026; others estimated. Replace weekly from checkonchain URPD.

tier3._src_oscillators: Public readings, Jul 21 2026. Pipeline pulls live if GLASSNODE_API_KEY set.
tier3._src_m2: US M2 proxy — pipeline computes from FRED if key set; global composite is manual.

strategy._src_strategy: SEC 8-K, Aug 10 2026 (self-binding disclosure) + market quotes. Update after each weekly 8-K.

history._note: Optional. Hand-entered series win over pipeline history. Format: "key": [["YYYY-MM-DD", value], ...]. Keys: mvrv, mvrv_z, nupl, sopr, puell, reserves, lth, sth_cb, cb_prem, poly_p100, poly_p50, etf_flow, wma200, wma200x, ssr, m2_yoy, corr_gld, corr_qqq, gtrends, funding, fng. Without entries here, the pipeline appends one snapshot per run day, so charts build themselves from your weekly edits.
